title: George H.W. Bush, George W. Bush and Cheney's role in the legacy program

tellings.quote: George HW Bush as the director of CIA uh was read in allegedly to this uh legacy so-called legacy program and that um and that he passed on what he knew about that to his son George W.

plain: Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, repeats a claim linked to David Grusch, a witness who has spoken out about hidden government UFO work. According to McConnell, George H.W. Bush was allegedly told about a secret "legacy program" holding UFO material while he ran the CIA, America's foreign spy agency, around 1976, and later passed what he knew to his son George W. Bush, with Dick Cheney also playing a part. If true, it would mean the secret was handed down among the country's most powerful leaders for decades.
